text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 20, "unit": "marbles", "kind": "count", "span": "Solomon bought 20 marbles from Johanna"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 50, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "added them to a store that had 50"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "2/5 times as many marbles as he bought (numerator)"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "2/5 times as many marbles as he bought (denominator)"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 2, "unit": "kgs", "kind": "mass", "span": "each marble weighs 2kgs"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q3"], "out": "s1", "note": "numerator of two fifths of what he bought"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s1", "q4"], "out": "s2", "note": "marbles his father gave him"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s3", "note": "marbles he bought plus those already in the store"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s3", "s2"], "out": "s4", "note": "all the marbles in the store"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s4", "q5"], "out": "s5", "note": "total weight at 2 kg per marble"}], "target": {"kind": "mass", "scope": "the total weight of the marbles Solomon has in the store"}, "dismissed": []}
